table.retrieve:
SELECT
	REPORT=RTRIM(LTRIM(DISTCODE)) + ',' +
	RTRIM(LTRIM(CHEMCODE)) + ',' +
	RTRIM(LTRIM(CHEMTYPE)) + ',' +
	RTRIM(LTRIM(PRODCODE)) + ',' +
	RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(SALES))) + ',' +
	RTRIM(LTRIM(FRM)) + ',' +
	RTRIM(LTRIM(T))
FROM 
(SELECT
	DISTCODE=:AS_DISTCODE,
	CHEMCODE=RTRIM(LTRIM(A.ALIASNAME)),
	CHEMTYPE=CASE SOUNDEX(CT.NAME) 
			WHEN 'RETAILER' THEN 'R'
			WHEN 'WHOLE SALER' THEN 'W'
			WHEN 'INSTITUTE' THEN 'I'
			ELSE LEFT(CT.NAME, 1) END,
	PRODCODE=RTRIM(LTRIM(I.CUSTOMICODE)),
	SALES=SUM((SD.LOOSEQTY + SD.BONUSQTY)),
	FRM= LTRIM(STR(DATEPART(DAY, :ad_startdate))) + '/' + LTRIM(STR(DATEPART(MONTH, :ad_startdate))) + '/' + LTRIM(STR(DATEPART(YEAR, :ad_startdate))), 
	T=LTRIM(STR(DATEPART(DAY, :ad_enddate))) + '/' + LTRIM(STR(DATEPART(MONTH, :ad_enddate))) + '/' + LTRIM(STR(DATEPART(YEAR, :ad_enddate)))

FROM
	SALELEDGER SL, 
	MANUFACTURER MA, 
	SALEDETAIL SD,
	ITEM I, 
	CUSTOMER C, 
	CUSTOMERCATEGORY CT, 
	ACCOUNTS A

WHERE 
	SL.DATE BETWEEN GETDATE()-100 AND GETDATE() AND
	SL.SALEINVCODE = SD.SALEINVCODE AND
	SD.ICODE = I.ICODE AND
	I.MANFCODE = MA.MANFCODE AND
	MA.MANFCODE = :ai_ManfCode AND
	SL.CUSTCODE = C.CUSTCODE AND
	C.CUSTCODE = A.ACCCODE AND
	C.CUSTCATCODE = CT.CUSTCATCODE

GROUP BY 
	A.ALIASNAME,
	CT.NAME,
	I.CUSTOMICODE,
	I.ICODE

UNION ALL
SELECT
	DISTCODE=:AS_DISTCODE,
	CHEMCODE=RTRIM(LTRIM(A.ALIASNAME)),
	CHEMTYPE=CASE SOUNDEX(CT.NAME) 
			WHEN 'RETAILER' THEN 'R'
			WHEN 'WHOLE SALER' THEN 'W'
			WHEN 'INSTITUTE' THEN 'I'
			ELSE LEFT(CT.NAME, 1) END,
	PRODCODE=RTRIM(LTRIM(I.CUSTOMICODE)),
	SALES=-SUM((SD.LOOSEQTY + SD.BONUSQTY)),
	FRM= LTRIM(STR(DATEPART(DAY, :ad_startdate))) + '/' + LTRIM(STR(DATEPART(MONTH, :ad_startdate))) + '/' + LTRIM(STR(DATEPART(YEAR, :ad_startdate))), 
	T=LTRIM(STR(DATEPART(DAY, :ad_enddate))) + '/' + LTRIM(STR(DATEPART(MONTH, :ad_enddate))) + '/' + LTRIM(STR(DATEPART(YEAR, :ad_enddate)))

FROM
	SRLEDGER SL, 
	MANUFACTURER MA, 
	SRDETAIL SD,
	ITEM I, 
	CUSTOMER C, 
	CUSTOMERCATEGORY CT, 
	ACCOUNTS A

WHERE 
	SL.DATE BETWEEN :ad_startdate AND :ad_enddate AND
	SL.SRINVCODE = SD.SRINVCODE AND
	SD.ICODE = I.ICODE AND
	I.MANFCODE = MA.MANFCODE AND
	MA.MANFCODE = :ai_ManfCode AND
	SL.CUSTCODE = C.CUSTCODE AND
	C.CUSTCODE = A.ACCCODE AND
	C.CUSTCATCODE = CT.CUSTCATCODE

GROUP BY 
	A.ALIASNAME,
	CT.NAME,
	I.CUSTOMICODE,
	I.ICODE) T

ORDER BY
	DISTCODE,
	CHEMCODE, 
	CHEMTYPE, 
	PRODCODE
